mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collection_record (record_id, task_id, user_id, method, result, promised_pay_date, remark, operator_name) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{method}, #{result}, #{promisedPayDate}, #{remark}, #{operatorName})
mapper.select: SELECT id, record_id, task_id, user_id, method, result, promised_pay_date, remark, operator_name, create_time FROM collection_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND result = 'promised'
